source_text: Historia sola non sufficit: populus sponte ad puteum conveniret. Praeceptum congregandi ad spiritualem intelligentiam remittit — aquam verbi Dei haurire.
pass_a_gloss: History alone not suffices: people of-own-accord to well would-come. Command of-gathering to spiritual understanding sends-back — water of-word of-God to-draw.
pass_b_english: Bare history is not enough — the people would come to drink of themselves. The command to gather them sends us to spiritual sense: draw the water of God’s word.
